dct_title_s: Europe NUTS 2 Demographics : Esri Data & Maps 2012
dct_description_sm: Abstract: Europe NUTS 2 Demographics represents areas of aggregated socioeconomic and demographic information at the NUTS 2 level for Europe. NUTS 2 units have an average population between 800,000 and 3,000,000 people.NUTS (Nomenclature des Unites Territoriales Statistiques) refers to the Nomenclature of Territorial Units for Statistics. For more information: http://epp.eurostat.ec.europa.eu/portal/page/portal/nuts_nomenclature/introduction.
Purpose: Europe NUTS 2 Demographics provides NUTS 2 level demographic information for Europe.
Supplemental information: Largest scale when displaying the data: 1:100,000.
